d_right_part2 = not not d_right_calc2  # not not True = True

d_right_and = d_right_part1 and d_right_part2  # False and True = False

D = d_left_final and d_right_and  # True and False = False

print("OPTION E:")

# Last part: not not (max(-1, 5, 6, -6) - min(-1, 5, 6, -6) <= 4)
